name: openGym
description: Self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker. Plan routines, log workouts (supersets and cardio), track weight and progress, and sign in with passkeys. Your data stays on your server.
author: DuarteSantos8

form_fields.label: Passkey RP ID
form_fields.hint: Hostname only — no https://, no port, no trailing slash. Must match the hostname in the browser address bar. localhost works only in a browser on the Runtipi host. For phones, expose the app with HTTPS and set this to that hostname (e.g. gym.home.arpa or opengym.example.com). Changing this later invalidates existing passkeys.

form_fields.label: Passkey Origin
form_fields.hint: Full origin with scheme and no trailing slash. Must match the address bar exactly. Examples: http://localhost:8088 (host browser only) or https://opengym.example.com (HTTPS expose). After changing RP ID or Origin, recreate the containers — restart is not enough.

form_fields.label: Passkey RP Name
form_fields.hint: Name shown in the browser passkey prompt

form_fields.label: Session length (days)
form_fields.hint: How long a sign-in lasts. Only affects new sign-ins. Users can still sign out everywhere from Settings.

form_fields.label: Allow guest mode
form_fields.hint: Offer Continue without account. Guest data stays in that browser and never hits the server. Turn off for a private household instance.

form_fields.label: Invite-only signup
form_fields.hint: Require an invite code to create a profile. Existing accounts keep working. Generate codes from the admin dashboard after setting Admin user IDs.

form_fields.label: Admin user IDs
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated user ids that get the admin dashboard. Register a passkey first, then copy users[].id from the data volume db.json.
